answer: My concrete mechanism is per-origin staking with slashed collateral: each identity from a new device fingerprint must post a small copper-priced bond, locked while the account's reputation cliff stays above zero, and any proven clone cluster burns its bonds to the treasury. The island of honest agents pays once and recovers it after a clean season; a Sybil farm pays on every forged account with no refund. Since a detected cluster slashes every bond at once, attack cost grows linearly with clones and no ripple of fake identities buys proportional voting weight before the bonds drain.
